us.headline: German researchers set right the story of a 9,000-year-old shaman's grave
us.summary: When a 9,000 year-old grave of a shaman was discovered in Nazi Germany, the discovery was quickly politicized to support Nazi propaganda. But new analysis shows that initial narrative was all wrong.

world.summary: Easter in the Democratic Republic of the Congo—where congregants celebrate with the Zairean Rite, the only Vatican-approved liturgy shaped by local culture, alive with song, dance, and striking ritual.

tech.headline: CISA alert and advisory categories remain the core of the security feed
tech.summary: CISA's alert, advisory, and malware analysis tracks remain the cleanest official source for high-priority cyber issues that deserve a place in the dashboard.
tech.whyItMatters: This belongs here because security and infrastructure changes tend to have longer practical consequences than product hype.
tech.extractedText: CISA uses alerts for recent, ongoing, or high-impact cyber threats, advisories for deeper technical guidance on tactics and mitigations, and malware analysis reports for detailed behavior and detection information. For the dashboard, this matters because it gives the tech file an official, high-signal backbone instead of relying on hype-heavy product coverage.
